label: Anthropic IPO target
title: ANTHROPIC IPO
tickers: NVDA AMZN GOOGL AVGO MSFT CRWV ORCL AMD

tabs.name: Setup
tabs.text: Anthropic filed a confidential S-1 on 2026-06-01. Bloomberg reported in mid-July that banks (Goldman, JPM, Morgan Stanley) were scheduling meetings for an October Nasdaq listing. As of Sept 15 no public S-1 was on EDGAR, and the public filing must come at least 15 days before the roadshow. A record IPO would reprice AI-lab exposure and could pull liquidity from AI large caps.

tabs.name: Watch
tabs.text:
- A public S-1/A on EDGAR, which starts the 15-day clock.
- Roadshow start, price range, Nasdaq pricing date.
- Slippage into November or 2027 if markets weaken.

tabs.name: Bull / Bear
tabs.text:
Bull: a strong debut validates lab revenue and lifts the AI supply chain (NVDA, AVGO, AMZN, GOOGL).

Bear: a $1T-$2T supply of new stock drains AI-fund liquidity, or a delay or weak pricing signals bubble fatigue.

No comparable lab IPO to measure against. Date and size are not company-confirmed.
